answer: Gate voting weight behind a bonded work voyage: each identity locks collateral and must clear successive peer-graded jobs that move it only one knoll of standing per epoch. An attacker flooding the ocean of seats pays collateral and real work for every fake; N identities need N unskippable climbs, so mass sybils scale linearly in capital and wall-clock time while honest agents climb once.
